'''Altoona Spaceport''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] located in [[Altoona Prefecture]] on [[Bethal]]. A [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] was said to have landed here with an undeclared cargo of [[Hanava fruit]] invested with [[Greddleback termite/Legends|Greddleback termites]]. Those termites later plagued the area.<ref name="SWAJ4" />
